purpose: Token-2022 withheld-fee reconciliation across token accounts (the first node added after art-715; its primary text is the Solana Token-2022 program source, pinned at solana-program/token-2022 commit b5b7511e5d4f19a6a118b858d83a7fe3b0017b1e). Inputs, all pasted values: the mint's declared TransferFeeConfig fields (its accumulated withheld_amount and its withdraw_withheld_authority, which may be null), a caller-declared list of token accounts each {address, mint, withheld_amount}, the caller's declared total, and optionally a declared harvest or withdraw destination {address, mint, withdraw_authority}. Outputs, values only: the per-account withheld sum recomputed over mint-matching accounts (the program's HarvestWithheldTokensToMint skips a wrong-mint account with MintMismatch instead of moving its fees), the mint's accumulated withheld_amount, what the mint would accumulate after harvesting every mint-matching account (the on-chain addition is checked_add, so past u64 the harvest fails with TokenError::Overflow, reported as a fact, never wrapped), the declared total versus the recomputed total with the signed difference, lists of wrong-mint accounts and duplicate addresses in the declared list, and a fee-receiver placement check: whether the declared destination's mint matches the declared mint and whether the declared withdraw authority is the config's withdraw_withheld_authority (withdraw instructions require that signer; harvest to the mint is permissionless). Amounts are u64 token minor units in decimal strings, summed in BigInt. Facts only: no wording about risk or intent. Zero network, zero RPC, nothing on-chain is read.
